newsitem.title: USA: Kaiser Ventures completes land sale.
newsitem.headline: Kaiser Ventures completes land sale.

text.p: Kaiser Ventures Inc said on Monday it has completed a deal to sell 54 acres of land near the California Speedway near Los Angeles to Penske Motorsports Inc for $13.35 million.
Kaiser said it received $5 million in cash and about 254,000 Penske common shares valued at about $8.35 million. It will record a fourth quarter gain of around $6.7 million to account for the sale.
Kaiser boosted its ownership interest in Penske to 1.6 million shares from 1.37 million. It now holds a 10.56 percent stake in Penske valued at over $40 million, it said.
